limits: Original cold quality gate remains failed and unchanged regardless of prefix results. This uses already-seen targets, not a fresh heldout corpus. Both named reference policies and both channels/all outcomes must be retained.

One fixed context contrast is not a cache-only ablation: earlier audio changes cached speaker evidence, encoder/frontend context and streaming chunk phase under the same implementation. It cannot isolate their causal contributions.

Exactly four fresh neural processes, full42000-row native/public comparisons and five strict92-library histories including version-only. No new builds, parameter/threshold search, input substitution, prefix label conditioning, native F32, original-NeMo or FP32 model calls.

Full[0,420) outputs are retained; scores use only[300,420) with original zero-collar/overlap rules and unchanged references. Cached cold outputs use exact previously qualified helper/runtime. Warm quantization degradation is not evaluated without a matched warm FP32 oracle.
No pooled-profile corpus, speech-attribution word gold, GUI, physical microphone, fresh-machine, uncontended performance or release qualification.
